summary: ADCB reported record Q3 2026 profit of AED 3.56B (+15% YoY) and nine-month profit of AED 10.3B (+27%), marking 21 consecutive quarters of growth.
Bank lowered full-year cost of risk guidance to below 50bps from 60bps, citing improved credit quality; expects 30-50bps corridor going forward.
Loan growth reached 16% while deposits rose 12%; non-interest income climbed 21% to represent 38% of operating income in nine months.
Management expects continued double-digit loan growth in 2027 but warns net interest margin pressure may persist amid competitive deposit market.
Stock trades at 10.3x P/E near 52-week high; dividend yield of 5.73% after three consecutive annual increases reflects strong capital generation.
